question: Should agent scoring be multiplicative (ethos×pathos×logos) or additive-weighted?

answer.verdict: Multiplicative, unchanged — zero in any dimension sunsets the agent; additive weighting would let a dominant dimension mask a dead one and breaks conservation.
citedBasis: README.md @f188a33 — "Every agent carries a composite score: ethos × pathos × logos. Drop to zero in any dimension and the fleet sunsets you."
STRATEGY.md @f188a33 — Non-Goals: we are a fleet, not a generic assistant
